The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it is used in the sense of 'inferior or subordinate to'.

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय-अनु

The affix णमुल् comes after the roots having the sense of हिंस 'to injure, to strike' when the object of this gerund is the same as the object of the main verb and when the noun with which it is compounded ends with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix.

Terms: णमुल्

The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप and प्रति and the sense 'to cause suffering'.

Terms: सुट् augment

The न of हिनु and मीना is changed to ण , when coming after an उपसर्ग containing in it a cause of change.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-धातु-उपसर्ग
